④been → being: rather than 뒤에 동명사(V-ing) 필요. rather than being limited.
①for themselves → to themselves: keep ~ to oneself 숙어. for가 아닌 to.
③overlook(간과) → reconsider(재고): 데이터를 재고하는 맥락. overlook은 반대.
④ignores(무시) → depends(의존): every scientist depends on. ignores는 반대.

①명성 목적: 본문에 없음. 목적은 society knowing more. 불일치 → ①.
②reconsidering → to reconsider: for other scientists to reconsider (for+O+to V 구문).
